# Squarespace
> Squarespace is an all-in-one website builder and business platform for websites, ecommerce, domains, scheduling, marketing, and payments.

Squarespace helps individuals, creators, and businesses build websites, sell products and services, manage bookings, market their brand, and run online operations from a unified platform. Its product ecosystem includes website design tools, ecommerce, domains, email campaigns, scheduling, invoicing, payments, and developer resources.

## Core Platform
- [Website Builder – Easily Create Your Own Website](https://www.squarespace.com): Main product overview for building websites with templates, AI tools, and integrated business features.
- [Website Design](https://www.squarespace.com/website-design): Overview of Squarespace’s design system, editor, templates, and site-building capabilities.
- [Templates](https://www.squarespace.com/templates): Browse website templates for portfolios, stores, blogs, services, and business websites.
- [Domains](https://www.squarespace.com/domains): Search, register, transfer, and manage domain names through Squarespace.
- [Pricing](https://www.squarespace.com/pricing): Compare website, commerce, and business plan options and included features.
- [Enterprise](https://www.squarespace.com/enterprise): Platform information for larger organizations needing scale, governance, and support.

## AI, Design, and Site Building
- [AI Website Builder](https://www.squarespace.com/websites/ai-website-builder): AI-assisted website creation flow for generating a site structure and initial design.
- [Design Intelligence](https://www.squarespace.com/design-intelligence): AI-powered design and content tools that support site creation and optimization.
- [Blueprint AI](https://www.squarespace.com/blueprint): Guided setup experience for creating a personalized website starting point.
- [Fluid Engine](https://www.squarespace.com/websites/fluid-engine): Drag-and-drop editing system for flexible page layout and responsive design.
- [Website Design Services](https://www.squarespace.com/professional-website-design): Professional design help for customers who want a site built for them.
- [Logo](https://www.squarespace.com/logo): Create a simple logo asset for use on websites, social profiles, and branding materials.

## Ecommerce and Selling
- [Ecommerce Website Builder](https://www.squarespace.com/ecommerce-website): Overview of online store features for selling products, services, and subscriptions.
- [Online Stores](https://www.squarespace.com/online-stores): Store management tools including merchandising, checkout, shipping, and order workflows.
- [Ecommerce Templates](https://www.squarespace.com/ecommerce/designs-that-sell): Store-focused templates designed for product presentation and conversion.
- [Sell Products](https://www.squarespace.com/sell-products): Product selling capabilities for physical goods, digital products, and subscriptions.
- [Point of Sale](https://www.squarespace.com/point-of-sale): In-person selling tools that connect retail transactions with online inventory and orders.
- [Member Areas](https://www.squarespace.com/member-areas): Create gated content, memberships, and subscriber-only sections on a website.

## Services, Scheduling, and Payments
- [Services](https://www.squarespace.com/services): Tools for selling appointments, classes, consultations, and service-based offerings online.
- [Scheduling](https://www.squarespace.com/scheduling): Acuity Scheduling product for appointment booking, calendar sync, and client management.
- [Invoicing](https://www.squarespace.com/invoicing): Create invoices, collect payments, and manage billing for service businesses.
- [Payments](https://www.squarespace.com/payments): Payment processing features for online sales, invoicing, and business transactions.
- [Tap to Pay](https://www.squarespace.com/tap-to-pay): Mobile payment acceptance using compatible devices for in-person transactions.
- [Pay Link](https://www.squarespace.com/pay-link): Shareable payment links for collecting payments without a full checkout flow.

## Marketing and Audience Growth
- [Email Campaigns](https://www.squarespace.com/email-marketing): Built-in email marketing for newsletters, promotions, and automated campaigns.
- [SEO Tools](https://www.squarespace.com/seo): Search engine optimization features and guidance for improving site visibility.
- [Social Media Tools](https://www.squarespace.com/social-media): Tools and integrations for connecting websites with social channels and content promotion.
- [Unfold](https://www.squarespace.com/unfold): Content creation app for social storytelling, branded posts, and visual marketing assets.
- [Analytics](https://www.squarespace.com/analytics): Reporting tools for traffic, sales, audience behavior, and business performance.
- [Extensions](https://www.squarespace.com/extensions): Third-party integrations for marketing, fulfillment, finance, and store operations.

## Use Cases and Website Types
- [Portfolio Websites](https://www.squarespace.com/websites/create-a-portfolio): Build portfolio sites for showcasing creative work, projects, and client services.
- [Blog Websites](https://www.squarespace.com/websites/create-a-blog): Blogging tools for publishing articles, organizing content, and growing an audience.
- [Business Websites](https://www.squarespace.com/websites/create-a-business-website): Website builder for small businesses needing branding, lead generation, and online presence.
- [Restaurant Websites](https://www.squarespace.com/websites/create-a-restaurant-website): Templates and features for menus, reservations, and restaurant marketing.
- [Wedding Websites](https://www.squarespace.com/websites/create-a-wedding-website): Personal wedding sites with event details, RSVPs, and registry links.
- [Online Courses](https://www.squarespace.com/content): Tools for selling digital content, memberships, and educational products.

## Help Center and Guides
- [Help Center](https://support.squarespace.com/hc/en-us): Main support hub for product documentation, troubleshooting, and account help.
- [Getting Started](https://support.squarespace.com/hc/en-us/categories/205815908-Getting-started): Introductory help articles for setting up and launching a Squarespace site.
- [Websites and Commerce](https://support.squarespace.com/hc/en-us/categories/205815898-Websites-and-commerce): Support documentation for website editing, ecommerce, and content management.
- [Domains and Email](https://support.squarespace.com/hc/en-us/categories/205815848-Domains-and-email): Help articles for domains, DNS, transfers, and email-related setup.
- [Scheduling](https://support.squarespace.com/hc/en-us/categories/115001514548-Acuity-Scheduling): Support resources for Acuity Scheduling setup and appointment workflows.
- [Video Collection](https://support.squarespace.com/hc/en-us/categories/360001195028-Video-collection): Video tutorials covering common setup, design, and business tasks.

## Developer Resources
- [Developer Platform](https://developers.squarespace.com): Central developer documentation for building on and integrating with Squarespace.
- [Developer Guides](https://developers.squarespace.com/guides): Guides for developers working with Squarespace sites, APIs, and integrations.
- [Developer APIs](https://developers.squarespace.com/apis): API documentation for available Squarespace developer interfaces and endpoints.
- [Developer Changelog](https://developers.squarespace.com/changelog): Updates and release notes for developer-facing platform changes.
- [Circle Developer Docs](https://developers.squarespace.com/circle-developer-docs): Resources for approved professionals and partners building client solutions.
- [JSON-T](https://developers.squarespace.com/json-t): Reference material for Squarespace’s JSON-T templating language.

- [Press and Media](https://www.squarespace.com/press): News, announcements, and media resources about Squarespace.
